name: reverse_image_search_urls
description: Generate reverse image search URLs for Google Images, TinEye, Yandex, and Bing. Use this to find where else a profile image appears online. FREE service - generates URLs for manual verification.

image_url.description: Direct URL to the profile image to search (e.g., LinkedIn profile picture URL)

name: reverse_image_search_file
description: Generate reverse image search upload instructions for a local image file. Use when you have downloaded a profile picture and want to search for it. FREE service - provides upload instructions.

image_path.description: Full path to the local image file (e.g., C:\Downloads\profile.jpg)

name: detect_ai_generated_face
description: Analyze profile image for AI-generated face indicators. Checks for common AI generation artifacts like perfect symmetry, unrealistic skin texture, warped backgrounds. FREE analysis with visual inspection guidelines.

image_url.description: URL to the profile image to analyze

name: extract_image_metadata
description: Extract EXIF metadata from image including camera model, date taken, GPS coordinates. AI-generated images typically lack camera metadata. FREE service. Requires Pillow library.

image_url.description: URL to the image to extract metadata from

name: verify_profile_image_consistency
description: Check if person uses the same profile image across LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter. Inconsistent images may indicate fraud. FREE verification with manual steps.

name: search_profile_image_online
description: Generate Google Image search queries to find profile pictures of a person at their claimed company. Use to verify if person's photos appear in legitimate contexts. FREE service.

person_name.description: Full name of the person (e.g., 'Gregory Dutton')

company_name.description: Company or organization name (e.g., 'Institute of Sustainable Biodiversity')

name: check_facial_recognition_databases
description: Get information about paid facial recognition services (PimEyes, FaceCheck.ID, Social Catfish) that can search for a face across the entire internet. PAID services - use only when stakes are high.

name: analyze_profile_image_quality
description: Analyze profile image quality, dimensions, file format to detect potential red flags like screenshots, AI generation, or stock photos. FREE analysis. Requires Pillow library.

image_url.description: URL to the profile image to analyze
